metadata.purpose: Open a buffer every configured number of source values, emit full buffers, and flush residual open buffers on completion.

conditions: Each full buffer has size n, with possible shorter residual buffers flushed at completion.
k can be less than n (overlap), equal to n (contiguous), or greater than n (gaps).
An empty source completes without a bufferCount value; error and cancellation never flush.

scope.parameters: Positive safe-integer size and stride; source count remains within safe-integer range
scope.callbacks: No user callback. Source values retain reference identity inside emitted arrays; emitted arrays are fresh snapshots.
scope.time: No timer or scheduler introduced. Source/notifier order is supplied by input sequence, including equal timestamps.
scope.reentrancy: Post-setup, atomic non-reentrant notifications; setup-time synchronous delivery, observer throw and cancellation during delivery are excluded.
exclusions: Invalid/zero/negative/fractional bufferCount arguments, count overflow and arbitrary producer reentrancy.
Synchronous notifier/source delivery during subscription setup, throwing observers/finalizers and cancellation during output delivery.
ObservableInput conversion outside Observable notifiers, universal symbolic equivalence and arbitrary mutation of output arrays by observers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire the source with no open buffers until the first source next.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Every result subscription has its own buffers and counters.
ownership.reset: Fresh arrays/counters per execution; Closed has no legal inputs.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Each source notification opens a buffer on stride boundaries, appends to every active buffer, then emits and removes every full buffer in open order.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved notifications; unsubscribe without a final buffer or synthetic complete.
No callback/scheduler work is introduced; exact finalizer microorder is excluded.

append the source value to active buffers

controls.description: source connected, buffers and input count remembered

rules.explanation: Construction is lazy. Each subscription initializes new state and acquires source inputs.

actions: open on stride boundary, append to all open buffers, emit and remove full buffers
rules.nextState: advance the input counter and retain incomplete buffers
rules.explanation: A buffer opens on source indices 0,k,2k,...; full buffers are emitted in order after the current value has been appended.
Completion flushes only open residual buffers; it never emits a new empty buffer if no source values created one.
Source error propagates unchanged; stored values are not emitted.
Cancellation silently stops the operator and releases its owned subscriptions.
